description: This Java source file defines the AuthActivity class used in an Android autofill service for managing autofill authentication. It handles user interactions for authentication, creates responses, and provides static methods to generate IntentSenders for different autofill scenarios.

classes.name: AuthActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity handling autofill authentication, presenting yes/no options and returning appropriate autofill responses or cancellation signals.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets content view, and sets click listeners for user responses.

methods.name: onYes
methods.description: Handles user acceptance, constructs autofill response, and finishes activity.

methods.name: onNo
methods.description: Handles user cancellation, sets result as canceled and finishes activity.

methods.name: newIntentSenderForDataset
methods.description: Creates an IntentSender specific for a given dataset.

methods.name: newIntentSenderForResponse
methods.description: Creates an IntentSender for an autofill response with hints and IDs.

methods.name: newIntentSender
methods.description: Private helper to create an IntentSender with various parameters for dataset or response.
